title: boerhavia gypsophiloides
intro: Boerhavia gypsophiloides, commonly known as 'Hog's Fennel', is a perennial herb belonging to the Nyctaginaceae family. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antidiabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Boerhavia gypsophiloides include its ability to reduce blood sugar levels, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
